entities.summary: Max Horkheimer was a German philosopher and sociologist best known for his role in developing critical theory as director of the Institute for Social Research, commonly associated with the Frankfurt School. Max Horkheimer was a writers & intellectuals from Zuffenhausen (1895-02-14, Zuffenhausen–1973-07-07). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
